svg.title: Uncanny Valley — Almost Human SVG Faces
svg.desc: Five SVG portraits with subtle distortions: asymmetric eyes, too-wide smiles, skin-smooth gradients, and slightly wrong proportions.

g.text: TILTED EYES · DOUBLE SMILE · HIGH FOREHEAD
EYES TOO FAR · NO LIDS · NO EXPRESSION
PAINTED SYMMETRY · BLUSH CIRCLES · LASH GRID

svg.text: each face is almost right — that's why it's wrong
